song.title: No Feed No Ads
song.style: English, mellow reggae, offbeat guitar, warm organ, deep bass, warm friendly male lead vocal, slightly raspy, 80 BPM
song.lyrics:
[Verse]
Nobody paid me for this sun
Nobody's selling me the breeze
Wearing my tee and my oldest boots
Saying hello to all the trees

[Chorus]
No feed, no ads, no end
Just a long road and a friend
No feed, no ads, no end
Round the bend and round again

shots.prompt: {moss} walks toward the camera on a country path, his raincoat open over a cream t-shirt, and gives a big thumbs up and a wink. The camera tracks backward. Bright morning sun.
{moss} stands on a hilltop with arms wide and eyes closed as the wind ruffles his raincoat. Low angle, static. Clear blue sky.
{moss} laces up his green rubber boots on a doorstep, humming. Static close-up. Warm morning light.
{moss} waves at a tall oak tree and a little bird pops out and chirps at him. Static medium shot. Dappled sunlight.

A cream t-shirt with a simple illustration of rolling green hills and a winding path shaped like an infinity loop hangs on a wooden hanger against a sunny cream wall, gently swaying in a breeze from an open window. Soft daylight, warm shadows. Static close-up.
{moss} meets a friend at a fork in the path and they bump fists, then walk on together. Static wide shot. Warm afternoon light.
{moss} shares a thermos of tea with his friend, sitting on a stone wall. Static medium shot. Golden light.
{moss} laughs as a goat leans over a fence and nibbles his yellow pom-pom. Static medium shot. Bright afternoon light.
{moss} and his friend walk off down a winding path into the sunset, arms over each other's shoulders. The camera slowly rises. Peach and gold, calm.

endcard.line1: No feed. No ads. No end.

caption: Moss's walk is not sponsored. Neither is the sunset. The Infinite Stroll tee just came along for the ride.
